user.title: Connect Jev Home Assistant Sentinel
user.description: Choose one route. Hosted Jev runs over the OpenRouter API key. Laya runs on this machine with no API key. Laya first with the hosted key as fallback asks the local server first, then sends the same redacted case to the hosted endpoint if the local server fails.

error.api_key_required: The hosted routes need an OpenRouter API key. Select Laya alone only when a local laya-serve is running.
